items.exampleEn: The teacher was not amused when I came late.
items.exampleZh: 我遲到時，老師一點也不覺得好笑。

items.exampleEn: My parents found my test results very pleasing.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽對我的考試成績很滿意。

items.exampleEn: A kindly nurse held my hand.
items.exampleZh: 一位親切的護理師握著我的手。

items.exampleEn: The cat jumped up on the table with grace.
The shop owner was dishonest about the price.

items.exampleZh: 我奶奶說的故事讓人難忘。

items.exampleEn: There is no excuse for laziness.

items.sentenceEn: The concert last night was unforgettable.
items.sentenceZh: 昨晚的演唱會令人難忘。

items.audioEn: The kids were amused by the clown's funny hat.
items.audioZh: 孩子們被小丑那頂滑稽的帽子逗樂了。
items.questionZh: 什麼讓孩子們覺得好笑？

items.sentenceEn: She moves with grace when she dances.
Laziness won't help you pass the test.
items.sentenceZh: 懶惰不會幫你通過考試。

items.stemEn: It's ____ to copy your friend's homework.
items.stemZh: 抄朋友的作業是不誠實的。

items.stemEn: A ____ old woman showed me the way to the station.
items.stemZh: 一位和藹的老太太告訴我去車站的路。

items.passageEn: Last summer, I visited my grandparents' village. A kindly old woman next door taught me to dance. She moved with grace. She did not like dishonest people, and she hated laziness. "Get up early and work hard," she said. I was amused by her funny stories, and the colors of her garden were very pleasing. It was an unforgettable summer.
items.passageZh: 去年夏天，我去了爺爺奶奶住的村子。隔壁一位和藹的老太太教我跳舞。她跳起舞來很優雅。她不喜歡不誠實的人，也很討厭懶惰。她說：「早起，努力工作。」她講的趣事常把我逗樂，她花園裡的色彩也很賞心悅目。那是一個難忘的夏天。

questions.questionZh: 隔壁的老太太教作者做什麼？

rubricZh: 若寫 a/an＋unforgettable＋名詞，冠詞用 an（例如 an unforgettable trip）

items.promptZh: 他因為懶惰而丟了工作。
referenceEn: He lost his job because of his laziness.
Because of his laziness, he lost his job.
rubricZh: 用 laziness 表示「懶惰」，because of 後面接名詞（例如 because of his laziness）
時態可用過去式或現在完成式（例如 lost、has lost 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：疑似：kindly 最常用的是副詞「親切地；好心地」（She kindly helped me），本課單字卡與 mcq q13、閱讀都只用較少見的形容詞用法（a kindly nurse），請依 CEFR-J 該級詞性確認。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：教課綱該級列的詞性。kindly 形容詞 A2、副詞 B1，維持形容詞「親切的」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last summer, I visited my grandparents' village. A kindly old woman next door taught me to dance. She moved with grace. She did not like dishonest people, and she hated laziness. \"Get up early and work hard,\" she said. I was amused by her funny stories, and the colors of her garden were very pleasing. It was an unforgettable summer."（原 "Last summer, I visited my grandparents' village. A kindly old woman next door taught me to dance. She moved with grace, even at eighty. She did not like dishonest people, and she hated laziness. \"Get up early and work hard,\" she said. I was amused by her funny stories, and the colors of her garden were very pleasing. It was an unforgettable summer."）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似：「冠詞用 an」對 That trip was unforgettable. 這類同樣正確、不用冠詞的寫法會誤判，建議改為「若寫 a/an＋unforgettable＋名詞，冠詞用 an」。
